Yeah, I ran solid, and the result was 
great too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I managed to keep my composure, so it 
shouldn't have been a bad race.

satisfy her.

text_block_list.text:

while we're standing here, everyone else 
is already making their move...!
